metadata.title: The S&P 500 keeps climbing on days when stocks broadly struggle. Here’s what’s going on. - MarketWatch

content.text:
Market Extra
The S&P 500 keeps climbing on days when stocks broadly struggle. Here’s what’s going on.
Big Tech has some ‘serious sway’ as investors keep a close pulse on AI
Investors’ intense focus on artificial intelligence is at times adding to the power of a small club of Big Tech stocks with mega market values to potentially make or break a single trading session for the S&P 500.
Just this past week, AI chip designer Nvidia’s NVDA second-quarter earnings results and guidance appeared to thrill investors — triggering a 8.7% rally in the company’s shares on Thursday that Dow Jones Market Data calculated as a record $441.5 billion jump in its market value, to $5.49 trillion. As the S&P 500 SPX has outsize weightings in Big Tech companies including Nvidia, the chip giant’s rally propelled the index higher Thursday, even as the average stock underperformed the S&P 500.
